description: Same quest-start primitive as paru-A sa1: tiny dead-end stub used as the quest's start cell. South portal at the gate, default spawn just inside where the player materializes on first entry. Autopilot ultimately leaves through load_south.

portals.south: spawn_south at (-0.03, 6.73) — the only portal, on the south (high-Z) side

anchors.description: default spawn — player materializes here on quest start (matches wp_spawn_default)

traversalNotes: Quest-start cell: on first entry the player materializes at quest_start, walks south to south_gate to exit. On re-entry via the portal, same exit path.
